# 核心响应数据结构说明

本文档由正式 v1.1.0 OpenAPI 的三个 Direct API 200 Response Schema 生成。
`Required=是` 表示 JSON 中必须出现；`Nullable=是` 表示值允许为 `null`。
扩展区仅有 `DirectExecutionDTO.usage` 和
`DirectGeneratedStructuredJobDTO.custom_fields`；其余核心对象均为强类型结构。

## JD Generate Response

```text
DirectJDGenerateResponseDTO
├── execution: DirectExecutionDTO
│   ├── request_id
│   ├── execution_ref
│   ├── root_trace_id
│   ├── child_trace_ids[]
│   ├── status
│   └── usage
└── business_result: DirectGeneratedJobResultDTO
    ├── schema_version
    ├── result_ref
    ├── jd_text
    └── structured_job: DirectGeneratedStructuredJobDTO
        ├── schema_version / result_ref / title
        ├── department / location / employment_type
        ├── description
        ├── responsibilities[] / qualifications[]
        ├── declared_requirements[]: DirectGeneratedRequirementDTO
        └── custom_fields
```

### DirectJDGenerateResponseDTO

| Field | Type | Required | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| `execution` | `DirectExecutionDTO` | 是 | 否 | — |
| `business_result` | `DirectGeneratedJobResultDTO` | 是 | 否 | — |

| Field | Type | Required | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|

| `status` | `string` | 是 | 否 | — |
| `root_trace_id` | `string` | 是 | 否 | — |
| `child_trace_ids` | `array<string>` | 是 | 否 | — |
| `usage` | `object / null` | 是 | 是 | — |

    ├── talent_type / talent_type_reason / talent_type_evidence[]

## Resume Match Response

```text
DirectResumeMatchResponseDTO
├── execution: DirectExecutionDTO
└── business_result: DirectMatchBatchResultDTO
    ├── schema_version / result_ref / execution_ref / status
    ├── implementation_code / policy_ref / job_snapshot_hash
    ├── input_count / succeeded_count / failed_count / hard_filtered_count
    └── candidates[]: DirectMatchCandidateResultDTO
        ├── input_order / attachment_ref / status / eligibility / rank
        ├── hard_filter_failed / vector_retrieval_executed / ai_match_executed
        ├── capabilities / failure_stage / error_code
        └── result: DirectResumeMatchResultDTO | null
            ├── result_ref / schema_version / result_status / eligibility
            ├── overall_score / score_coverage / recommendation / summary
            ├── hard_requirement_summary
            ├── hard_rule_results[] / criteria_results[]
            ├── strengths[] / risks[] / missing_items[] / uncertainties[]
            └── interview_suggestions[]
```
